title: 第13章 水舞忧伤

content_zh:
“就说这喝茶吧，也有许多规矩的，不同的场合、不同的地方，都各有不同的讲究。比如说，跟客人一起吃了饭，常常会上茶，这茶水可不能倒满，水只斟七成，切忌满到沿儿。”
这薛水舞还真是一位良母，逮着机会就不忘教育女儿，大概是想把女儿教育成真正的大家闺秀吧，刚才提到了茶，她便就茶道教育起了女儿。叶小天觉的幸好这小丫头年纪还小，天真烂漫的本性还在，要不然规规矩矩像个小大人儿似的未免无趣。
不过这些茶道上的讲究，叶小天了解的也不多，所以他在一旁听着倒是津津有味受益匪浅：“喝茶的时候如果水面飘着茶叶，就用碗盖压着喝，可别用茶盖撇几下或者吹一吹，那都是很失礼的事儿。
还有，喝茶要小口儿啜，再渴也别一饮而尽。要是一杯茶喝完了想续水，只要把碗盖拿起来靠在托碟上，主人就知道你要续水了，可别张口要，人家给你续水时要欠身致谢，
如果你是主人，给客人续水时一定要侧着身，手扶着壶盖儿，壶嘴儿别对着客人，那是骂人的意思。要是给人敬茶，敬完茶后别马上转身，要倒退三步再转身，否则也是不敬。”
叶小天在刑部天牢天天和一群朝廷大员厮混，懂的事情既多且杂，可是那些朝廷大员都是犯官，绝对没有兴致给他讲茶道，此时听来，不免就一一记在心里。
薛水舞用细土给女儿搓净了手，道：“好啦，自己洗吧。”
乐遥撅着小屁股蹲在渠水旁，哗啦哗啦地洗着小手，薛水舞一边洗手一边继续叮嘱道：“如果你去拜访地位比你尊贵的人而非宴请会唔，人家端来的茶就别喝，那是摆样子的。除非主人举手向你‘请客’，否则人家一端杯，侍从就会高呼‘送客’，那叫‘送客茶’。”
叶小天忍不住笑道：“想不到你竟懂得这么多事情，这都是你进了杨府后学来的么？”
薛水舞沉默片刻，幽幽地道：“奴家的父亲本是礼部仪制清吏司主事。”
叶小天大吃一惊，失声道：“你竟是官宦之后？怎么可能……”
薛水舞容颜惨淡，幽幽地道：“怎么会为人做小，是么？家父在仪制清吏司负责嘉礼、军礼、学务、科举。有一回，科场舞弊事发，为了平息士子之怒，相关人等不管是否有所牵连俱都受了处分，最轻的也抄没了家产，我家也就此家道中落……”
叶小天怔住了，心道：“这回我真占了大便宜啊！不但得了一个如花似玉的美人儿，她的出身还如此高贵，这可是礼部主事家里的千金小姐，只是……就算家道中落，也不致于惨到为人作妾吧，这其中……”
叶小天试探地问道：“如今你已得自由，为何不回家呢？”
薛水舞淡淡地道：“因为在我的父兄心里，我已经死了。”
叶小天愕然看着她，薛水舞仰起头，看着满天璀璨的星辰，黯然道：“我家也是书香门第，诗礼传家。家道本已中落，如果女儿为人作妾的消息再传出去，岂不斯文扫地？所以，在我决心卖身葬母的时候，我的家人……就已当我死了。”
叶小天讶然道：“卖身葬母？”
薛水舞低下头洗手，轻轻地道：“当时正逢朝廷追究家父的案子，我的母亲生了重病，家里也顾不及去医治，就此病逝了。家产被抄没后，家父唯恐滞留京城还会生出不测，是以急欲返回家乡，竟连家母的后都不想操办了，欲以草席一捆，草草埋葬。我一个弱女子，能怎么办呢？于是……，可父兄却以为我这卖身葬母，败坏了薛家门风，将我从此逐出家门……”
几颗晶莹的泪珠落入潺潺的流水之中，无声无痕。
叶小天听的又惊又怒：“这是何等凉薄的一户人家，又是何等的孝女！听这话音，水舞的母亲似乎是那礼部主事的妾室，是以受此待遇。说是名门贵女，遭遇忒也可怜。

叶小天本还担心水舞既有如此家世，自己断难与她匹配，不要说她貌美如花，纵然丑若无盐，就凭这出身自己也是拍马难及，如今终于放下心来，可是对她所遭遇的不公待遇，心头却也生起一蓬怒火。

content_en:
"Let's just talk about drinking tea. There are many rules. Different occasions and places have different rules. For example, when you have a meal with guests, tea is often served. The tea cannot be filled to the top. Only 70% of the water is poured. Don't fill it to the edge."
This Xue Shuiwu is really a good mother. She never forgets to educate her daughter whenever she gets the opportunity. She probably wants to educate her daughter to be a real lady. When tea was mentioned just now, she started educating her daughter on the tea ceremony. Ye Xiaotian felt fortunate that this little girl was still young and her innocent nature was still there, otherwise it would be boring to behave like a little adult.
However, Ye Xiaotian didn't know much about the details of these tea ceremonies, so he listened with relish and benefited a lot: "When drinking tea, if there are tea leaves floating on the water, use the lid of the bowl to press it down and drink. Don't use the lid to lift it a few times or blow on it. That is very rude.
Also, drink tea in small sips, and don’t drink it all in one gulp no matter how thirsty you are. If you want to refill a cup of tea after drinking it, just lift the lid of the bowl and lean it against the tray. The host will know that you want to refill the water. Don’t ask for it. When someone gives you a refill, you should bow down and thank them.
If you are the host, when refilling the water for the guests, you must turn sideways and hold the lid of the pot with your hand. Don't face the spout of the pot towards the guests. That is a curse. If you are serving tea to someone, don't turn around immediately after serving the tea. You should take three steps back and then turn around. Otherwise, it is also disrespectful. "
Ye Xiaotian hangs out with a group of court officials every day in the Prison Prison, and he knows many and complicated things. However, those court officials are all prisoners and have absolutely no interest in teaching him tea ceremony. When he heard this, he couldn't help but remember them all in his heart.
Xue Shuiwu rubbed her daughter's hands with fine soil and said, "Okay, wash it yourself."
Le Yao squatted by the canal with his little butt raised, washing his little hands. Xue Shuiwu continued to warn while washing his hands: "If you go to visit someone who is more distinguished than you instead of giving a banquet, don't drink the tea they bring. It's just for show. Unless the host raises his hand to 'treat' you, otherwise when the other person brings the cup, the attendant will shout 'see off the guest', which is called 'seeing off guests' tea."
Ye Xiaotian couldn't help but laugh and said: "I didn't expect you to know so many things. Did you learn all this after entering the Yang Mansion?"
Xue Shuiwu was silent for a moment and said quietly: "The father of the Nu family was originally the head of the Department of Ceremony and Cleaning of the Ministry of Etiquette."
Ye Xiaotian was shocked and lost his voice: "You are actually an official queen? How is it possible..."
Xue Shuiwu's face was pale and she said quietly: "How can you be so young, right? My father is responsible for ceremonies, military rituals, academic affairs, and imperial examinations in the Department of Ceremony and Cleaning. Once, there was an incident of fraud in the examination room. In order to appease the anger of the scholars, the relevant people were punished regardless of whether they were involved or not. The most minor ones also had the family property confiscated, and my family also fell into ruin..."
Ye Xiaotian was stunned and thought to himself: "I really got a big advantage this time! Not only did I get a beautiful woman like a flower, but she also came from such a noble family. She is the daughter of the head of the Ministry of Etiquette. It's just... Even if the family is in decline, she won't be miserable enough to be a concubine. Among them..."
Ye Xiaotian asked tentatively: "Now that you are free, why don't you go home?"
Xue Shuiwu said calmly: "Because in the hearts of my father and brother, I am already dead."
Ye Xiaotian looked at her in astonishment, and Xue Shuiwu raised his head, looked at the bright stars in the sky, and said sadly: "My family is also a scholarly family, with poetry and etiquette passed down to the family. The family has already fallen into decline. If the news of my daughter being a concubine spreads again, wouldn't it be polite and disgraceful? So, when I decided to sell myself to bury my mother, my family... already treated me as dead."
Ye Xiaotian said in surprise: "Sell yourself to bury your mother?"
Xue Shuiwu lowered his head and washed his hands, and said softly: "At that time, the court was pursuing my father's case. My mother was seriously ill, and the family did not bother to get treatment, so she died. After the family property was confiscated, my father was afraid that something bad would happen if he stayed in the capital., so eager to return to his hometown, he didn't even want to take care of his mother's wife, and wanted to bury her hastily with a bundle of straw mats. I am a weak woman, what can I do? So..., my father and brother thought that I had ruined the Xue family by selling myself to bury my mother, so they kicked me out of the family..."
A few crystal tears fell into the gurgling water, making no sound or trace.
Ye Xiaotian was shocked and angry when he heard this: "What a cold family this is, and what a filial daughter this is! Listening to these words, Shui Wu's mother seemed to be the concubine of the head of the Ministry of Etiquette, so she received such treatment. She is said to be a noble girl, but her situation is extremely pitiful.
Ye Xiaotian was originally worried that with Shui Wu's family background, it would be difficult for him to match her. Not to mention that she was as beautiful as a flower, and even though she was as ugly as salt, she would be unmatched by him just because of her background. Now he was finally relieved, but he felt angry at the unfair treatment she had received.
